author: Christopher Fahey
html: I wouldn't want to create the impression that pogosticking is inherently wrong. It can be fine in lots of contexts. It's only bad when it's used excessively and/or where another option (such contextual navs/links) would be better.

html: Hmm, I would have to agree for both sides but mainly as a user. I would prefer not to implement pogosticking because of the frustration to the web user by having to click here and click there over and over.
